Garbage Bread
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 18, 2009 - 11:44pm

Ingredients




2 loaves frozen bread dough
1 pound Italian Sausage, saute, drain & cool
Pepperoni, to taste
1 large onion, diced, saute, pat dry with paper towel & cool
Mozzarella cheese
Oregano, garlic powder, 
Preparation

1 Thaw bread, let rise, knead and let rise again. Roll out dough and above ingredients except seasonings in which you add over everything once it is in the bread.  2 Very carefully, roll up your bread, place on cookie sheet and bake for as long as the bread package says to. Bread must be cooled slightly before cutting.
